# 查询交易对配置 (USER\_DATA)

- **GET** `/capi/v3/account/symbolConfig`

权重(IP): 5

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 否 | 交易对，留空时返回全部交易对的配置 |

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/symbolConfig?symbol=BTCUSDT" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 交易对 |
| marginType | String | 保证金模式。CROSSED 表示全仓，ISOLATED 表示逐仓。 |
| separatedType | String | 分仓模式。COMBINED 表示合仓，SEPARATED 表示分仓。 |
| crossLeverage | String | 全仓杠杆倍数 |
| isolatedLongLeverage | String | 逐仓多单杠杆倍数 |
| isolatedShortLeverage | String | 逐仓空单杠杆倍数 |

**返回示例**

```
[
  {
    "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
    "marginType": "CROSSED",
    "separatedType": "COMBINED",
    "crossLeverage": "20",
    "isolatedLongLeverage": "20",
    "isolatedShortLeverage": "20"
  }
]
```
